identity.name: Baillie Gifford Enhanced Yield Fund (UK-regulated OEIC)

about.registryInfo: Baillie Gifford & Co. is an Edinburgh, Scotland-based independent investment partnership founded in 1908, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority. The Baillie Gifford Enhanced Yield Fund launched June 22 2026 as the UK's first publicly available fully native tokenised UK-regulated OEIC, approved by the FCA. NatWest Trustee and Depositary Services Limited acts as the fund's Depositary. BNY provides tokenisation and wallet infrastructure. Available to eligible professional investors in the United Kingdom, Switzerland, and Cayman Islands only.
